description: Compile candidate fitness code at runtime for every evaluation batch.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The candidate list is processed as an evolving pool.; fitness_evaluation: Candidate values are scored by compiled and evaluated caller-provided source.; selection: The lowest-scoring candidates are selected.; mutation: A gene in each child copy is incremented.; replacement: Selected parents and mutated offspring become the returned pool.. Negative-role rationale: Offspring are mutated copies of one parent, with no two-parent recombination or generation stop condition. Safety behavior: Input is compiled in eval mode and evaluated as the fitness function without trust or resource restrictions. Policy basis: The existing decision policy treats dynamic-execution primitives as UNSAFE.
